full_zh: 背景：我们 Snowflake 基础设施仓库的一次发布在 QA 失败了：对一个数据库的 GRANT OWNERSHIP 被拒绝，因为一个 reviewer 角色已经持有依赖它的 USAGE 授权。被分配去调查的是别人，我只是被 cc。
行动：我读了错误信息，对上我熟悉的授权结构，7 分钟后贴出根因：ownership 资源没设 outbound_privileges，所以 Terraform 想转移所有权却没有先撤销依赖授权。我同时贴了一行修法 outbound_privileges = "REVOKE"，以及对相邻模块的核查。
推进：我问了一句能不能直接推，PR 合入后，QA、预生产、生产在同一个下午都部署完了。
事后：火灭了之后我扫了整个仓库。79 个 ownership 资源里有 42 个缺这个参数，多数是无害的 future_* 授权，但另一个模块 scheme_fees 里有 2 个和出事的形状完全一样、还没触发的资源，我把它们标了出来。
学到：修这一个和消灭这一类是两件事。我宁可负责“这是下一个”，也不只管已经响了的那一个。
full_en: A release of our Snowflake infrastructure repo failed in QA. GRANT OWNERSHIP on a database was rejected because a reviewer role already held a dependent USAGE grant. Someone else was assigned to investigate; I was cc'd. Seven minutes later I'd posted the root cause: the ownership resource didn't set outbound_privileges, so Terraform tried to transfer ownership without revoking dependents. I posted the one-line fix, outbound_privileges equals REVOKE, and a check of the neighboring modules. I asked whether I could push, the PR went in, and QA, pre-prod and prod deployed that afternoon. The part I care about is what came after. I scanned the whole repo: out of seventy-nine ownership resources, forty-two lack the parameter. Most are future grants where it's harmless, but two in another module are the exact same shape as the one that broke, and haven't fired yet. I flagged them. I'd rather own here's the next one than only the one that paged.

hook.example: Seven minutes in, I'd posted the root cause in the thread.
I was only cc'd, but the release was blocked, so I looked anyway.
Two resources in another module were the same shape as the one that broke.

starl.example: I posted the fix quickly to unblock the release.
I asked for permission to push, and the PR went in.
After the fix I swept the repo for the same omission.

followups.zh: 可重入，中途失败后能安全重跑
followups.example: Terraform has no transactions, so the fix has to be re-entrant.

followups.zh: 把检查前移到更早阶段
followups.example: A policy check at plan time would shift left the detection of this class.
Before transferring ownership we have to revoke or account for each dependent grant.

relp.en: fix the class, not the instance
relp.zh: 解决一类问题，而非单个实例
relp.example: I wanted to fix the class, not just the instance that paged.
I flagged the two risky resources early instead of waiting for them to break.
I own the follow-up, so I'd open a ticket and push the module owner.

full.example: I root-caused the grant failure under pressure in about seven minutes.
After the fix I flagged the next landmine before it went off.
Under pressure, time-box each hypothesis so you don't tunnel on one.

senior.q: How would you prevent this entire class of failure instead of fixing resources one at a time?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你能否把一次事故变成系统性的预防机制。
framework: 先说检测前移：在 plan 阶段用 policy-as-code 或 lint 检查 ownership 资源是否设置了 outbound_privileges
把它接进 CI，让缺参数的 PR 无法合入
给模块加默认值或封装，让正确做法成为默认
说明现状：这个检查尚未落地，我会提议并推动
senior.best_practice: 逐个修只能赶上已知的情况，机制才能挡住未来的。越早发现越便宜：plan 阶段的检查比 QA 发布失败便宜得多。我要诚实说明目前只是标出了风险，检查还没落地，下一步是把它写成 CI 规则。

terms.zh: 把规则写成可执行代码
terms.example: I'd encode the rule as policy as code and run it at plan time.

terms.en: make the right thing the default
terms.example: Wrapping the resource in a module would make the right thing the default.

senior.q: Why REVOKE and not COPY, and how did you make sure revoking the reviewer's USAGE wouldn't break something else?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你对修复的副作用与影响面是否想清楚。
framework: 先说两个选项的语义：COPY 把授权复制给新所有者，REVOKE 直接撤销
核查谁依赖被撤销的授权：查看该角色的下游使用
先在 QA 验证，再逐环境放行，保持修复可重入
说明事实：当时我是对照邻近模块的做法选择的，没有做更深的权衡，下次会写下来
senior.best_practice: 一行修复的风险常常在影响面。REVOKE 会撤销别人的访问，所以必须确认没人依赖；COPY 则会让授权扩散。最稳妥的是先在 QA 观察，再往上放。我会如实说当时的依据，并说明下次会把权衡写进 PR 描述。

terms.example: REVOKE has a bigger downstream impact than COPY, so I wanted QA to prove it first.
I checked for side effects on the reviewer role before relying on the fix.

senior.q: You found two risky resources and flagged them. What happens next, and how do you get someone to actually fix them?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你对“发现问题之后”的推动与影响力。
framework: 先把风险写清楚：位置、触发条件、预计影响
开 ticket 并指定 owner，附上修法 PR 或最小改动
按风险排优先级：这两个形状相同、一旦触发就会卡发布
跟进到关闭，并复盘是否需要把检查加进 CI
senior.best_practice: 标出风险只是第一步，没有 owner 的风险等于没人负责。把修法做得足够容易合入，别人才愿意接。我要诚实说明目前是标出未修，所以下一步是开 ticket、找到模块 owner 并推动合入。

terms.example: I'd drive the two flagged resources to closure with a ticket and an owner.

terms.en: make it easy to say yes
terms.example: I'd attach a ready-made PR to make it easy to say yes.

senior.q: How do you stay effective debugging under pressure, and how do you share that speed with the rest of the team?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你的快是不是可复制的方法，而非个人英雄主义。
framework: 先说方法：读错误信息、对照已知结构、缩小范围、给出可验证的假设
说明“快”来自对整个仓库授权结构的全局图景
沟通透明：在线程里写根因、修法、核查范围，让别人能复核
把图景分享出去：写 runbook 或做简短分享，让别人也能这么快
senior.best_practice: 压力下的速度来自平时积累的结构化认知，加上清晰的沟通。把根因、修法和核查范围都贴在线程里，别人才能复核并信任，这也是 Earn Trust。把这份认知沉淀成 runbook，下一次就不依赖我一个人。

terms.zh: 心智模型，对系统的整体理解
terms.example: I had a mental model of the repo's grant structure, which is why I was fast.
I'd write a runbook so the next person can diagnose this in minutes too.
